fixed_operating_materials.goal_spec: Give an AI agent a small real training setup, fix one metric, keep one mutable file, and iterate experiments under a bounded time budget.
fixed_operating_materials.issue_decomposition: Setup branch and data, run baseline, modify train.py only, run fixed-budget experiment, read metrics, keep/discard, repeat.
fixed_operating_materials.tech_report: Report val_bpb, memory, status, description, crash/keep/discard evidence, and complexity tradeoff.
fixed_operating_materials.supervisor_decision_record: Keep lower val_bpb or meaningful simplification; discard worse or crash runs; do not widen the harness.

vectorfl_translation.external_candidate_search_brief: Use autoresearch as a bounded experiment-harness candidate, not as org/company/agent surface import.
vectorfl_translation.candidate_evidence_record: Represent one experiment-loop candidate as issue/run/result/governance surfaces.
vectorfl_translation.cross_check_review_report: Check whether the candidate proves shape, mapping, honesty boundary, and gate relevance without broadening VectorFL Paper.
vectorfl_translation.hold_continue_decision_manifest: Hold gate close unless the candidate is a true host export and supports reopen/gate evidence.

immediate_goal: Create one autoresearch-derived external candidate record and dry-run it through the actual_export_only validator without changing the current SSOT slot.
